build-type.name: ProteoWizard Publish Docker image (Skyline-daily)
build-type.description: Tags current master Docker container as Skyline-daily and pushes to DockerHub.

runner.name: Load, tag and push to Docker

parameters.param:
/usr/bin/docker load -i pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses.tbz2
# Avoid pipe operator in next line because it causes 403 error on TC (can't save config) /usr/bin/docker run --rm chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 bash -c "grep \"Skyline\" < <(wine SkylineCmd --version)" > SKYLINE_VERSION 2>&1 # Skyline-daily(64-bit) 23.1.1.535 (e56850ad6) echo "SKYLINE_VERSION:" cat SKYLINE_VERSION skylineVersion=$(sed -Ee "s/.*([0-9]{2}\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+) \(([0-9a-z]+)\)/\1-\2/" SKYLINE_VERSION | tr -d '\r')
/usr/bin/docker tag chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 proteowizard/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:skyline_daily_$skylineVersion /usr/bin/docker push proteowizard/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:skyline_daily_$skylineVersion
/usr/bin/docker rmi chambm/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:x64 \ proteowizard/pwiz-skyline-i-agree-to-the-vendor-licenses:skyline_daily_$skylineVersion
